name: oak-desktop-cloud
description: Run OAK MCP locally and use your private cloud store. No local database or Docker required.

store_id.title: Store ID
store_id.description: Copy the store UUID from your OAK dashboard. This must match the store for your personal key.

personal_key.title: Personal key
personal_key.description: Create a named connection key for this store in OAK. Enter it only here, never in chat. Claude stores this sensitive setting securely.

allow_changes.title: Allow memory changes
allow_changes.description: Off by default. Turn on only to permit creating, editing, merging, deleting and policy changes in this store. Server roles, credits and Claude approvals still apply. Autosave stays off.
